==Characteristics==
==={{LA|-}}===
In {{LA}}, the [[Chef Bear]] lives in the [[Animal Village]], where she operates a small cafeteria. The Chef Bear laments that she has no [[Honeycomb]]s for a dish she is preparing,<ref name="LA Chef Bear"/> which [[Link]] can give in exchange for the [[Pineapple]] as part of the game's [[Trading Quest]]. In doing so, the Chef Bear also gives advice in waking the [[Walrus]] south of the village.<ref name="LA Chef Bear 2"/>

When [[Marin]] visits the Animal Village to sing for the animals, a blue Bear can be found listening to her song.

==={{MM3D|-}}===
While no real Bears appear, a statue of a Bear's head can be seen in the [[Swamp Tourist Center]].

==={{OoS|-}}===
[[Moosh]] is a winged Bear that appears in {{OoS}}. He appears several times to aid Link on his quest, and can potentially become one of his animal companions by obtaining his [[Moosh's Flute]].

==={{OoA|-}}===
A red Bear is one of the animals found listening to [[Nayru (Oracle)|Nayru]]'s song at the beginning of {{OoA}}, entranced by her singing. It moves aside for Link after speaking with everyone so that he can sit and listen.<ref>{{Cite|Sit here and listen. How charming...|Bear|OoA}}</ref> The Bear and all of the other listeners are then scared away when [[Veran]] reveals herself. After Link saves the [[Maku Tree]] in the past and returns to the present, the red Bear can be found again in the same grove in the [[Forest of Time]], lamenting that there are no more songs.{{Fact}} The red Bear also reappears in the game's post-ending, listening to Nayru's singing.

[[Moosh]] also appears in {{OoA|-}}, serving an identical role to his appearance in {{OoS}}.

==={{BotW|-}} and {{TotK|-}}===
In {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}, [[Honeyvore Bear]]s and [[Grizzlemaw Bear]]s appear as wild animals. They will generally ignore and avoid Link, but may attack if provoked. It is possible for Link to mount Bears and ride them. However, they cannot be registered at [[Stable]]s.

==Other Appearances==
==={{OoA|-}} (Himekawa)===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
A single large Bear is at the front of the [[Animal]] mob that forbids [[Link]] and [[Impa]]'s entry deeper into the forest.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= Go back. Go back. Go back.|book= {{OoA (Himekawa)|-}}|publisher= VIZ Media|page= 22}}</ref> The Bear and other Animals allow Impa and Link to pass after realizing the hero is a [[Hylian]] of the old blood.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= His ears are pointed. He's a Hylian. A Hylian of the old blood!|book= {{OoA (Himekawa)|-}}|publisher= VIZ Media|page= 23}}</ref>
{{Noncanon|End}}
